fusions.name: Sticky Flick
fusions.desc: A flicked lash on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at the end of its reach. It has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Belly Flop
fusions.desc: Slams down, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. You restore 10 health.

fusions.name: Shed Skin
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health to you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Slick Margins
fusions.desc: Every blow you dodge builds a stack, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and heal you for 3% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
